### Remove RSI > 2 as per preregistration
```{r RSI}
time_model <- aov(TIME_SUM ~ as.factor(RN01), data = dblthnk_data)
summary(time_model)

TukeyHSD(time_model)


dblthnk_data_rsi <- dblthnk_data %>%
  group_by(RN01) %>% 
  mutate(
    median_time = median(TIME_SUM, na.rm = TRUE),
    RSI = median_time / TIME_SUM,
    exclude_RSI = RSI > 2
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

dblthnk_data<- dblthnk_data_rsi %>% 
  filter(!exclude_RSI)

write_sav(dblthnk_data, "study3_data_filtered.sav")
write.csv(dblthnk_data, "study3_data_filtered.csv")


tab1(dblthnk_data$RN01)

```

```{r renaming, include=FALSE}

names(dblthnk_data)[names(dblthnk_data) == "DA09_09"] <- "DA09_01"
names(dblthnk_data)[names(dblthnk_data) == "DC09_09"] <- "DC09_01"
names(dblthnk_data)[names(dblthnk_data) == "DB08_08"] <- "DB08_01"
names(dblthnk_data)[names(dblthnk_data) == "DD08_08"] <- "DD08_01"

# Helper: safely extract a column (returns all NA if missing)
get_col <- function(df, nm) {
  if (nm %in% names(df)) df[[nm]] else rep(NA, nrow(df))
}

for (i in 1:11) {
  # ---- OLD variable names (per item i) ----
  # Block A (Exp 1 & Exp 2)
  da <- paste0("DA", sprintf("%02d", i), "_01")  # e.g., "DA01_01"
  dc <- paste0("DC", sprintf("%02d", i), "_01")  # e.g., "DC01_01"
  
  # Block B (Exp 1 & Exp 2)
  db <- paste0("DB", sprintf("%02d", i), "_01")  # e.g., "DB01_01"
  dd <- paste0("DD", sprintf("%02d", i), "_01")  # e.g., "DD01_01"
  
  # ---- NEW variable names ----
  dt1 <- paste0("DT01_", sprintf("%02d", i))     # e.g., "DT01_01"
  dt2 <- paste0("DT02_", sprintf("%02d", i))     # e.g., "DT02_01"
  
  # ---- Create unified DT variables ----
  # BLOCK A → DT01 (take DA if present, else DC)
  dblthnk_data[[dt1]] <- dplyr::coalesce(
    get_col(dblthnk_data, da),
    get_col(dblthnk_data, dc)
  )
  
  # BLOCK B → DT02 (take DB if present, else DD)
  dblthnk_data[[dt2]] <- dplyr::coalesce(
    get_col(dblthnk_data, db),
    get_col(dblthnk_data, dd)
  )
}


```

```{r dblthnk calculations, include=FALSE}

# vector of item names
items1 <- paste0("DT01_", sprintf("%02d", 1:11))
items2 <- paste0("DT02_", sprintf("%02d", 1:11))

# for each pair: 1 if both items >= 3, else 0
par_mat <- (dblthnk_data[items1] >= 3 & dblthnk_data[items2] >= 3) * 1L
colnames(par_mat) <- paste0("dt_par", 1:11)

# add to dataset
dblthnk_data <- cbind(dblthnk_data, par_mat)

# doublethink sum score
dblthnk_data$doublethink <- rowSums(par_mat, na.rm = TRUE)

describe(dblthnk_data$doublethink)


```

```{r REI, include=FALSE}

dblthnk_data <-
  dblthnk_data %>% mutate(
    rei_r1_re = Recode(
      dblthnk_data$rei_r1, "1 = 5; 2 = 4; 3 = 3; 4 = 2; 5 = 1"
    ),
    rei_e1_re = Recode(
      dblthnk_data$rei_e1, "1 = 5; 2 = 4; 3 = 3; 4 = 2; 5 = 1"
    ),
    rei_e4_re = Recode(
      dblthnk_data$rei_e4, "1 = 5; 2 = 4; 3 = 3; 4 = 2; 5 = 1"
    ))

dblthnk_data <-
  dblthnk_data %>% mutate(REI_rational = rowMeans(subset(
    dblthnk_data, select = c(rei_r1_re, rei_r2:rei_r4)
  )))

dblthnk_data <-
  dblthnk_data %>% mutate(REI_exp = rowMeans(subset(
    dblthnk_data,
    select = c(rei_e1_re, rei_e2:rei_e3, rei_e4_re)
  )))


```


```{r rename factor, include=FALSE}

dblthnk_data$group <- factor(
  dblthnk_data$RN01,
  levels = c(1, 2),
  labels = c("control", "exp")
)

```

### Descriptives

```{r descriptives}

descriptives <- dblthnk_data %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    `Mean age` = sprintf("%.2f", mean(SD02_01, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `Female` = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)",
                       sum(SD01 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                       mean(SD01 == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100),
    `Male` = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)",
                     sum(SD01 == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
                     mean(SD01 == 2, na.rm = TRUE) * 100),
    `Other` = sprintf("%d (%.1f%%)",
                      sum(SD01 == 3, na.rm = TRUE),
                      mean(SD01 == 3, na.rm = TRUE) * 100),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -group,
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = group,
    values_from = Value
  ) %>%
  mutate(Variable = factor(
    Variable,
    levels = c("Mean age", "Female", "Male", "Other")
  )) %>%
  arrange(Variable)

descriptives

dblthnk_data %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_doublethink = mean(doublethink, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_doublethink   = sd(doublethink, na.rm = TRUE),
    n                = sum(!is.na(doublethink))
  )


```
